'''2015 San Diego Grand Prix''' was a Players Committee major event in San Diego, California, 9–11 January 2015. [[Joe Olson]] finished 1st. The numbered tournament-decklists accordion is placement order ([[Kevin Shannon]] 2nd, [[Brian Fred]] 3rd); the wrap numbered Fred 2nd.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-san-diego-grand-prix/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' San Diego, California
* '''Dates:''' 9–11 January 2015
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Olson]]
